contract: Coalesce edits to each editor visit through the trailing-task utility. After 120 ms without another edit in a burst, persist only that burst’s latest text; later bursts must also persist. Keep accepted edits durable when a visit is closed or replaced, so reopening restores them. A synchronous submit must capture the text accepted at entry and return its receipt; callback reentry must not change that snapshot or transfer its confirmation to a different visit. Preserve the synchronous public and injected interfaces, existing subscription and receipt behavior, and the separate search preview behavior.

unknowns: The source does not explicitly prescribe a particular settlement method for pending edits at departure.
No shared lazy cancellation mechanism is established for the editor target.
